data.name: Priscilline
data.gender_notes: Priscilline is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin priscus, meaning ‘ancient, old, precious’. The feminine form, Priscilla, was borne by a number of early Christian saints and martyrs. Priscilline is a variation and conveys the same meaning: a precious, ancient one. The name Priscilline carries the meaning “Precise, Dainty, Little One” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Priscilline usually hope their child will grow to embody precise, dainty, little one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the ancient wisdom and knowledge of the divine.
data.etymology: Priscilline belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Precise, Dainty, Little One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Priscilline total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: פריסקילין
in_hebrew.meaning: נולדה בארץ צרפת, שושנת השדות הרומית
in_hebrew.long_meaning: פריסקילין היא שם נוצרי שמקורו בשם הרומי פריסקילה, שפירושו 'קטנה' או 'צעירה'. השם נגזר מהשורש הלטיני 'priscus', שפירושו 'עתיק' או 'ישן'. השם פריסקילין משמש כנראה כחיבה או כצורה נשית של השם פריסקוס. במסורת הנוצרית, השם פריסקילה מוזכר בברית החדשה, בספר מעשי השליחים, כשליחת פאולוס.

in_greek.name: Πρισκιλίνη
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Πρισκιλίνη είναι μια νεοτερική μορφή του Ρωμαϊκού ονόματος Πρίσκιλλα, που σημαίνει 'μικρή' ή 'νέα'. Η προέλευση του ονόματος βρίσκεται στο λατινικό 'priscus', που σημαίνει 'αρχαίος' ή 'παλαιός'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα Πρίσκιλλα αναφέρεται στο βιβλίο των Πράξεων των Αποστόλων ως σύντροφος του Παύλου.

in_latin.long_meaning: The name Priscilline originates from the Roman name Priscilla, which is derived from the Latin 'priscus', meaning 'ancient' or 'old'. The name Priscilla was popularized by the early Christian church, particularly through the New Testament reference in Acts of the Apostles. Priscilline likely serves as a feminine diminutive form or variant of the original name.

In Christian tradition, Priscilla is a significant name mentioned in the New Testament, specifically in Acts of the Apostles, as a companion of Saint Paul. data.cultural_impact: Priscilla is a historically significant name, as it was borne by several saints and martyrs in the early Christian Church. The name, which derives from the Latin word 'priscus', meaning 'ancient', emphasizes the historical and traditional roots of Christianity.
data.spiritual_significance: Priscilla is an evocative name with deep spiritual significance. It embodies the idea of the ancient and enduring nature of Christian faith and values. The name evokes images of women of deep spiritual strength and conviction, holding fast to their beliefs even in the face of persecution. Priscilla is a reminder of the wisdom and depth of the Christian tradition, a treasure to be passed down from generation to generation.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Priscilline: Dedicated to the ancient Roman woman of noble character and faith, inspiring devotion and strength in Christian women.

biblical_reference.note: Priscilla is mentioned alongside Aquila as a companion of Saint Paul.

historical_references.reference: Priscilla and Aquila were early Christian Jews who became prominent evangelists in Rome. They hosted a house church in their home and taught Apollos, an eloquent speaker from Alexandria, the way of God. Priscilla is believed to have been the more learned of the two. This account is recorded in the New Testament, Acts 18:24-26, and Acts 18:26.

Priscilla was also a companion of the Apostle Paul. She and her husband Aquila were expelled from Rome by Emperor Claudius in around AD 49 and travelled to Greece. They eventually settled in Corinth, where they became influential members of the Christian community. They returned to Rome around AD 54, when Paul visited the city. Priscilla is believed to have been a key figure in Paul's ministry and may have authored or co-authored some of his letters.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Priscilline has gained popularity in modern times due to its association with femininity, empowerment, and leadership. In social media, accounts with the name Priscilline can be found showcasing a range of interests from fashion and beauty to activism and entrepreneurship. In the fashion industry, designers have used the name for collections or brands that embody power and elegance. In literature, there are characters named Priscilline who are strong, independent women. The name is also popular among parents who want to give their daughters a unique and meaningful name with a strong history and contemporary relevance.
